mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the average 20d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which in turn reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the average 20d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction term and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, following a prior 3-month upward trend, signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100.0 and INDPRO declined by >2.0pp over prior 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 5d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average signals strong aggregate demand growth, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60d forward return is not significantly positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 is above its 4-quarter moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% signals persistent inflation and a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the joint signal and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k, or the average 20d return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0, combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0%, signals a simultaneous supply shock and labor market deterioration, which increases uncertainty and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 5d returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction term and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
